0.content: Danica Postelnitskaya is head housemaid of the Snezhnayan royal household and, with Vesna, one of the Tsaritsa's two right hands: Vesna executes military decrees, Danica state affairs. They met as children studying under Capitano. They once climbed onto his shoulders trying to steal his mask, Danica's idea according to Vesna, and were made to stand at attention on a frozen lake for hours. Vesna pranks her endlessly: lemon slices in her plate and tea, doodles under her teacups, unwanted vegetables slipped onto her plate (they always come back). Danica warns new maids to ignore it, because a reaction only delights the culprit. Vesna insists she is two whole months older and complains that Danica now acts like the adult. Danica says Vesna acts on a whim and criticises her driving.

1.content: When the Tsaritsa gave ten-year-old Vesna a Druzhna recruit's badge, the First Harbinger Capitano became her teacher; Pulcinella said it was Capitano's idea. He told her to call him "Teacher". He crouched to her eye level and removed his mask to show her that he too carried an extraordinary power that was never truly his, of the same order as her Life authority. Even without it, he said, he would be no lesser a man. The early spring had come for her, not for the power. He wanted to see her at the pinnacle of the Druzhna, and she got there.

2.content: The Tsaritsa visited the Strivozha estate after Vesna's unusual birth and named the baby herself: Vesna, "the spring that walks beside her". She is the only Strivozha in five centuries named by Her Majesty. The Tsaritsa watched over her growth and sent Pulcinella to ask her "What is love?". She gave Vesna a Druzhna badge rather than a political career, and later the elegant outfit Vesna wears. Vesna serves her as the "keen blade" of the Druzhna, and attends ribbon-cuttings and banquets on her behalf while the war on the Heavenly Principles goes on. Her battle cry is "For the Tsaritsa!"

3.comment: Vesna: Authority of Life and the Seals of Life
3.content: In the Hyperborean age the former Archangel stole a fragment of power from the Ruler of Life, Naberius. It passed from hand to hand and was entrusted to the first Vila, Vesna's direct ancestor. In Vesna it awakened for the first time in five hundred years. In 7.1, with Mitya bearing the mark of Death, the Tsaritsa revealed at the Armory Palace that Vesna bore the "mark of life", spoiling Vesna's dramatic build-up. Prompted by Sandrone, Vesna showed that she could draw "Seals of Life": iridescent bubbles holding a person's most cherished memories, whose life force might, gathered en masse, defy Ronova's Curse of Death. She drew them from the court, then from officials and nobles, with donation compulsory for those ranks, and from eager volunteers at the Northland Bank, until she was run off her feet.

4.content: The Druzhna is the Tsaritsa's personal guard, mostly Vila, answering only to her. The Belyi Tsar founded and led it; the Tsaritsa later took it as her own. Vesna is its Commander-in-chief. Its duties go beyond war: protecting Her Majesty, campaigns against monsters, containing Shadow Realm breaches, law enforcement, and anything touching the Tsaritsa's "authority and honor". Vesna will not lend it out as private help, though "Vesna the Vila" is happy to help.

5.content: When Vesna was about ten, a "special tutor" arrived at the Strivozha estate on a stormy night. It was Pulcinella, Mayor of Snezhnograd and Fifth Harbinger, sent by the Tsaritsa. He called her "Miss Fern" with her mother's permission and confirmed that the Tsaritsa had never wholly trusted House Strivozha. He explained why: Gluvasha's poisoning of Grand Duke Photius and her double game in the rebellion. Three days later Vesna drove a dagger into the table and offered her blood. Flustered, he explained that the Tsaritsa's question was simply "What is love?" She answered: "Love is creation!" To her it was the power to create strength, laughter, courage and hope for those you cherish.
